sentences.en: In flagrant defiance of all his orders, it broke out of the line, abandoning the planned formation and striking out alone across the sea.
sentences.zh: 它公然违抗了所有的命令，脱离了战列，放弃了既定的阵型，独自向海上冲去。

sentences.en: The admiral's jaw dropped.
sentences.zh: 海军上将惊得下巴都掉了下来。

sentences.en: He was bearing down on the gigantic enemy flagship, the Santissima Trinidad.
sentences.zh: 他正逼近敌军那艘庞大的旗舰——“三位一体”号。

sentences.en: Guns blazing for death or glory.

sentences.en: The British have been driven out of the Mediterranean by Napoleon's advances on land.
sentences.zh: 由于拿破仑在陆地上的推进，英国人已被驱逐出地中海。

sentences.zh: 他穿过了直布罗陀海峡。

sentences.zh: 他在大雾中航行穿过了西班牙舰队。

sentences.zh: 令他宽慰的是，他在圣文森特角附近与约翰·杰维斯爵士会合了，这位外号“老橡树”、长相酷似蟾蜍、百折不挠的海军上将。

sentences.en: And now, Jervis has the chance to draw up his plans and to strike for victory.
sentences.zh: 现在，杰维斯有机会制定计划并发起决战以夺取胜利。

sentences.en: And the scene is set for what the British hope will be a decisive clash.
sentences.zh: 英国人所期望的那场决定性冲突已经拉开帷幕。

sentences.en: And the reason why this really matters is that Jervis, of course, is, you know, he's down off the coast of Spain and Portugal.
sentences.zh: 这之所以如此重要，是因为杰维斯当然身处西班牙和葡萄牙海岸附近。

sentences.en: But his main thoughts are surely focused on the Channel.
sentences.zh: 但他主要的精力无疑都集中在海峡上。

sentences.en: Because the risk is, is that if the Spanish fleet is able to continue on its way northwards to Brest in France and to join up with the French fleet,

sentences.en: then even though the Royal Navy is the largest fleet in the world, the combination of the second largest, the French, and the third largest, the Spanish,
sentences.zh: 那么即使皇家海军是世界上规模最大的舰队，将第二大的法国舰队和第三大的西班牙舰队结合起来，

sentences.en: I mean, potentially it could threaten Britain with the loss of the control of the Channel.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可能会威胁到英国对海峡控制权的丧失。

sentences.en: And that would open up a possibility of a French invasion.
sentences.zh: 那将为法国入侵创造可能性。

sentences.en: Exactly so.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.zh: 但他认为他们必须现在就迎战西班牙人，以阻止他们会合。

sentences.en: And he is confident, as he later put it, in the skill, valour and discipline of the officers and men I had the happiness to command.
sentences.zh: 正如他后来所说的那样，他对“我有幸指挥的军官和士兵的技能、英勇和纪律”充满信心。

sentences.en: And that is not just patriotic boosterism.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是爱国主义的吹嘘。

sentences.en: That is a genuine, realistic appreciation of the Royal Navy's qualities as opposed to those of the Spanish Navy.
sentences.zh: 这是对皇家海军品质与西班牙海军品质相比所做出的真诚、现实的评估。

sentences.en: And perhaps specifically of the fighting quality of the captains that he has promoted and favoured.
sentences.zh: 或许也具体体现了他所提拔和青睐的舰长们的战斗素养。

sentences.en: And one of the things I think that Jervis has instilled in his captains is that there is the letter of an order and there is the spirit of an order.
sentences.zh: 我认为杰维斯向他的舰长们灌输的理念之一就是，命令有字面之分，也有精神之别。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.zh: 他正试图鼓励他的舰长们在机会来临展现主动性。

sentences.zh: 这正是纳尔逊后来所做的。

sentences.en: And so Nelson gets that, I think, from Jervis.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为纳尔逊是从杰维斯那里学到了这一点。

sentences.zh: 因此，在纳尔逊到达的那天，杰维斯把他调到了另一艘更大的船上。

sentences.en: The captain, 74 guns.
sentences.zh: “卡普坦”号，装备74门大炮。

sentences.zh: 他很高兴地发现这艘船状况极佳。

sentences.en: The crew have been drilling and drilling with the guns all the time, preparing for this opportunity.
sentences.zh: 船员们一直在不断地用大炮进行演练，为这个机会做准备。

sentences.zh: 那天晚上，杰维斯让他的船只保持紧密的阵型。

sentences.zh: 他们能听到远处大雾中西班牙人的信号炮声。

sentences.en: Because he's really, I mean, he's risen from nothing.
sentences.zh: 因为他真的是，我的意思是，他白手起家。

sentences.en: He was an old seaman.
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名老水手。

sentences.en: He's properly meritocratic, and they always used to say, nobody hates the French more than Thomas Trubridge.
sentences.zh: 他真正体现了任人唯贤，人们总是说，没有人比托马斯·特鲁布里奇更恨法国人。

sentences.en: You know, he really does burn with zeal for king and country.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他确实对国王和祖国燃烧着狂热的忠诚。

sentences.en: So his lookouts have spotted ships, and the British start to advance very slowly, deliberately.
sentences.zh: 所以他的瞭望员发现了敌舰，英国人开始非常缓慢、审慎地前进。

sentences.en: People who remember our Trafalgar series will remember that you don't often charge into these battles.
sentences.zh: 还记得我们特拉法加系列的听众会记得，你通常不会冲进这样的战斗中。

sentences.en: You proceed in a very stately kind of considered way.
sentences.zh: 你以一种非常庄严、审慎的方式推进。

sentences.en: It's like a kind of dance, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这就像是一种舞蹈，不是吗？

sentences.zh: 你们在彼此对面排成一行。

sentences.en: That's the convention.
sentences.zh: 这就是惯例。

sentences.en: And there is a wonderful, wonderful story told of this.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点有一个非常精彩的故事。

sentences.zh: “胜利”号的舰长正通过望远镜观察。

sentences.en: Jervis is on the victory, but of course he's not the captain of that ship because he's the commander in the entire fleet.
sentences.zh: 杰维斯在“胜利”号上，但他当然不是那艘船的舰长，因为他是整个舰队的最高指挥官。

sentences.en: And so at this point, the captain of the victory is clearly thinking, there are far too many of them, you know.

sentences.en: Let's get out of here.

sentences.zh: 而杰维斯只是说：“够了，先生。”

sentences.zh: “休得再言。”

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 我认为这主要是因为，皇家海军既在推动、同时又在不断打磨和提升工业化和全球化的进程，

sentences.en: Britain has a weapon of lethal destructiveness, rather in the way that with the longbows and the use of longbowmen and men-at-arms in the Hundred Years' War.
sentences.zh: 英国拥有了一种具有致命毁灭性的武器，就像百年战争中的长弓、长弓手和重装步兵一样。

sentences.en: For a brief time, they were able to impose themselves on the greatest power in Christendom.
sentences.zh: 在短暂的一段时间里，他们得以压制基督教世界中最强大的力量。

sentences.en: This is really the only other period where Britain has a kind of cutting-edge offensive weapon.
sentences.zh: 这真的是英国拥有某种尖端进攻性武器的另一个时期。

sentences.en: And the French and the Spanish respect that and indeed fear it.
sentences.zh: 法国人和西班牙人对此既尊重又畏惧。

sentences.en: So to give a sense of the battle picture, the Spanish ships are in two divisions.
sentences.zh: 为了展现战局的全貌，西班牙舰队分成了两个纵队。

sentences.en: They have 18 ships first and then nine.
sentences.zh: 他们先是有18艘船，然后是9艘。

sentences.en: And they're in very ragged formation, so Jervis can tell they're not quite at it.
sentences.zh: 它们的阵型非常散乱，所以杰维斯一眼就能看出他们状态不对。

sentences.en: The British, they are advancing sort of in a calm, steady, controlled way, now flying the colours of the Union Jack.
sentences.zh: 英国人则以一种冷静、稳定、受控的方式推进，现在正悬挂着英国国旗。

sentences.en: And the plan there is that, effectively, they will advance on the Spanish fleet and then they will tack, which means kind of zigzagging upwind towards the larger Spanish division.
sentences.zh: 这个计划实际上是让他们向西班牙舰队推进，然后转向，也就是顶风呈“之”字形驶向较大的西班牙分舰队。

sentences.en: And they will cut the Spanish in two.
sentences.zh: 他们将把西班牙舰队切成两半。

sentences.en: They will deal with the first larger division of the Spanish, then they will turn back to deal with the second division.
sentences.zh: 他们将对付西班牙较大的第一纵队，然后回过头来对付第二纵队。

sentences.en: And of course, this is not the formal dance of battle that the Spanish would expect.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不是西班牙人所预期的那种形式化的战场舞蹈。

sentences.en: And it bears witness to the fact that this, I suppose, really, an impatience with the limitations of fighting simply in a line, you know, one against the other.
sentences.zh: 这也证明了，我猜，对那种仅仅排成一线、一对一作战的局限性的不耐烦。

sentences.en: That it's not just Nelson, that this is something that, you know, the entire officer class of the Royal Navy is starting to get to grips with.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是纳尔逊一个人的想法，皇家海军的整个军官阶层都开始意识并适应这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, Hotham hadn't, but Jervis clearly has.
sentences.zh: 我是说，霍瑟姆没有，但杰维斯显然意识到了。

sentences.en: Jervis absolutely has.
sentences.zh: 杰维斯绝对意识到了。

sentences.en: Yes, he has.
sentences.zh: 是的，他意识到了。

sentences.en: So leading the line is Thomas Troubridge's Culloden.
sentences.zh: 因此，打头阵的是托马斯·特鲁布里奇的“卡洛登”号。

sentences.en: Victory is in the centre and actually Nelson's captain is towards the back.
sentences.zh: “胜利”号位于中心，而纳尔逊的舰长实际上在偏后的位置。

sentences.en: At the very back is his friend Cuthbert Collingwood's ship.
sentences.zh: 排在最末尾的是他的朋友卡斯伯特·科林伍德的船。

sentences.en: Excellent.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: On they go.
sentences.zh: 他们继续前进。

sentences.en: At 11.30, Culloden reaches the enemy line.
sentences.zh: 11点30分，“卡洛登”号抵达敌方阵线。

sentences.en: At this point, Jervis sends the signal saying now is the time to zigzag upwind and to cut the Spanish fleet in two.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，杰维斯发出了信号，说现在是时候顶风曲折前进并把西班牙舰队切成两半了。

sentences.en: And already the kind of gun smoke is starting to, the Spanish are starting to fire.
sentences.zh: 硝烟已经开始弥漫，西班牙人也开始开火了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Jervis has been on the quarter deck and now he goes up onto the poop deck to get a better sense of the action.
sentences.zh: 杰维斯原本一直在后甲板上，现在他走上了后桅楼甲板，以便更好地观察战局。

sentences.en: His ship is kind of wreathed in smoke.
sentences.zh: 他的船几乎被浓烟所包裹。

sentences.en: And while he's standing there, an officer can't duck, even as bullets are firing or cannon or whatever.
sentences.zh: 就在他站在那里的时侯，即使子弹或炮弹不断飞过，一名军官也无法躲闪。

sentences.en: And as he's standing there, a cannonball smacks into the head of an officer next to him.
sentences.zh: 正当他站在那里时，一颗炮弹击中了紧挨着他的一名军官的头部。

sentences.en: Jervis is absolutely spattered by blood, brains, fragments of skull.
sentences.zh: 杰维斯身上溅满了鲜血、脑浆和头骨碎片。

sentences.en: He wipes the gore from his face very coolly and lowers his telescope and stumps back to the quarter deck.
sentences.zh: 他非常冷静地擦掉脸上的血迹，放下望远镜，又大步走回了后甲板。

sentences.en: Love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太精彩了。

sentences.en: That's exactly how I would behave on a ship.
sentences.zh: 这正是我在船上的表现方式。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我懂的。

sentences.en: As the firing starts, Jervis realises that something has gone very badly wrong with his plan.
sentences.zh: 随着炮击开始，杰维斯意识到他的计划出了大问题。

sentences.en: That basically, the ships that are succeeding, the second lot of British ships, have missed his last signal in the confusion, in the chaos, in the smoke.
sentences.zh: 基本上，那些成功跟进的第二批英国船只，在混乱、纷乱和硝烟中错过了他的最后信号。

sentences.en: So they're not tacking.
sentences.zh: 所以他们没有转向。

sentences.en: And they are not tacking.
sentences.zh: 他们没有转向。

sentences.en: They are not turning to deal with the First Division.
sentences.zh: 他们没有掉头去对付第一纵队。

sentences.en: And without getting massively into kind of the minutiae naval tactics, what this means is it will take time for them to turn.
sentences.zh: 在不深入讨论海军战术细节的情况下，这意味着他们需要时间才能调头。

sentences.en: In that time, the smaller Spanish ships will get away.
sentences.zh: 在这段时问里，较小的西班牙船只将得以逃脱。

sentences.en: They will be able to run to the sanctuary of their home port, which is Cadiz.
sentences.zh: 他们将能够逃到他们的大本营加的斯寻求庇护。

sentences.en: And on the other hand, the larger Spanish division will probably also manage to get away.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，较大的西班牙分舰队可能也会成功逃脱。

sentences.en: They will be able to loop round and rejoin their comrades.
sentences.zh: 他们将能够绕个圈子，与他们的战友重新会合。

sentences.en: And it's at that point that he sees one British ship disobeying his orders, striking off alone, breaking the attack formation and heading straight for the enemy flagship,
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时侯，他看到一艘英国船只抗命不遵，独自冲了出去，打破了进攻阵型，直奔敌方旗舰而去，

sentences.en: that's Santissima Trinidad.
sentences.zh: 那就是“圣地亚哥·特立尼达”号。

sentences.en: And who is it?
sentences.zh: 那是谁？

sentences.en: It is Nelson.
sentences.zh: 是纳尔逊。

sentences.en: It's Nelson.
sentences.zh: 是纳尔逊。

sentences.en: It's Nelson on the captain.
sentences.zh: 是乘着“卡普坦”号的纳尔逊。

sentences.en: So Nelson has been watching all this on the captain.
sentences.zh: 所以纳尔逊一直在“卡普坦”号上密切注视着这一切。

sentences.en: He knows that he's under strict instructions.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己接到了严格的指令。

sentences.en: Do not abandon the attack formation.
sentences.zh: 不要放弃进攻阵型。

sentences.en: Stay in formation.
sentences.zh: 保持阵型。

sentences.en: But as soon as he sees that something is going wrong, Nelson thinks, I will ignore the letter of the law.
sentences.zh: 但一看到情况不对，纳尔逊就想，我才不管那些清规戒律。

sentences.en: I'll go with the spirit of the law.
sentences.zh: 我要遵从精神实质。

sentences.en: I will go with the spirit.
sentences.zh: 我要顺应大局。

sentences.en: You know, it's gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，事情搞砸了。

sentences.en: I'll take it into my own hands.
sentences.zh: 我要自己作主。

sentences.en: I'm going to go straight for the biggest ship on earth, the Santissima Trinidad.
sentences.zh: 我要直奔地球上最大的战舰——“圣地亚哥·特立尼达”号。

sentences.en: But just to emphasize the balls of Nelson in doing this, it's not just that he is charging alone, you know, this vast ship.
sentences.zh: 但为了强调纳尔逊在做这件事时的胆量，这不仅仅是他孤身一人向这艘庞然大物发起冲锋。

sentences.en: It's also the fact that the entire structure of the Navy is founded on obedience.
sentences.zh: 还在于海军的整个结构都建立在服从的基础之上。

sentences.en: And particularly in battle, to flout instructions, you know, it goes against every instinct of a service that depends on strict discipline for its very survival.
sentences.zh: 特别是在战斗中，蔑视指令，你知道，这违背了一个依赖严格纪律才能生存的服务机构的每一项本能。

sentences.en: And if it all goes wrong, if the Spanish fleet still gets away, or even more, if the British start losing ships, then Nelson will be the scapegoat.
sentences.zh: 如果一切都搞砸了，如果西班牙舰队仍然逃脱了，或者更糟糕的是，如果英国开始损失战舰，那么纳尔逊将成为替罪羊。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对会。

sentences.en: He will be ruined.
sentences.zh: 他会被毁掉的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, I mean, he could be core marshalled.
sentences.zh: 噢，我是说，他可能会被送上军事法庭。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对会的。

sentences.en: But that gamble changes the course of the battle.
sentences.zh: 但这一赌博改变了战斗的进程。

sentences.en: It shows incredible courage.
sentences.zh: 这展现了无与伦比的勇气。

sentences.en: He is firing on this enormous ship.
sentences.zh: 他正在向这艘庞大的战舰开火。

sentences.en: The Spanish are firing.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人也在开火。

sentences.en: There's enemy shot ripping into his sails and his rigging.
sentences.zh: 敌人的炮弹正在撕裂他的风帆和索具。

sentences.en: Other Spanish ships begin to converge on him.
sentences.zh: 其他西班牙船只开始向他聚拢。

sentences.en: But the fact that he does that means they don't get away because they turn to fight him.
sentences.zh: 但他这样做意味着敌人无法逃脱，因为他们转过身来与他战斗。

sentences.en: The thing is, it shows incredible courage, but also it's very effective.
sentences.zh: 关键是，这不仅展现了令人难以置信的勇气，而且非常有效。

sentences.en: By going straight at this huge Spanish ship, he has bought time for the other ships, British ships, to change course and to follow him.
sentences.zh: 通过直奔这艘巨大的西班牙战舰，他为其他英国战舰赢得了时间来改变航向并跟随他。

sentences.en: But also he's stopped the Spanish from breaking away because instead of rushing for Cadiz, they've turned to deal with Nelson.
sentences.zh: 而且他也阻止了西班牙人的逃跑，因为他们没有急于逃往加的斯，而是转过身来对付纳尔逊。

sentences.en: So within moments, you know, he's engaged in this colossal kind of firefight with the Spanish ship.
sentences.zh: 因此，转眼之间，你知道，他就与这艘西班牙战舰陷入了激烈的交火中。

sentences.en: But British ships are now coming to his aid.
sentences.zh: 但英国战舰现在正赶来救援他。

sentences.en: Truebridge and Culloden.
sentences.zh: 特鲁布里奇和“卡洛登”号。

sentences.en: Collingwood in the excellent...
sentences.zh: 科林伍德和那艘优秀的……

sentences.en: So all the lads.
sentences.zh: 所以所有的伙计们都来了。

sentences.en: All his pals.
sentences.zh: 他所有的死党。

sentences.en: Yeah, all his pals.
sentences.zh: 对，他所有的死党。

sentences.en: The captain is taking horrendous damage.
sentences.zh: “卡普坦”号正遭受着惨重的破坏。

sentences.en: So its main mast is riddled with holes, while the mast is blasted overboard.
sentences.zh: 它的主桅杆千疮百孔，副桅杆则被炸飞落入海中。

sentences.en: The wheel is splintered.
sentences.zh: 舵轮被打得粉碎。

sentences.en: The sails are shredded.
sentences.zh: 风帆被撕成碎片。

sentences.en: Yeah, and splinters are really dangerous, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 对啊，木屑飞溅真的很危险，不是吗？

sentences.en: So it's not just the cannonballs.
sentences.zh: 所以不仅仅是炮弹本身。

sentences.en: It's when the cannonball smacks into wood and the splinters go out.
sentences.zh: 当炮弹击中木头并产生飞溅的木屑时才是最危险的。

sentences.en: And at this point, Nelson is hit by a massive splinter in the side of his stomach.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，纳尔逊的腹侧被一块巨大的木屑击中。

sentences.en: So this is another...
sentences.zh: 所以这是又一次……

sentences.en: It's not as kind of obviously bad as the wound to his eye, which blinds him in that eye.
sentences.zh: 它不像伤及眼睛那样明显糟糕到导致那只眼睛失明。

sentences.en: But it is...
sentences.zh: 但它……

sentences.en: I mean, it causes him trouble for the rest of his life.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这给他的余生带来了麻烦。

sentences.en: It's a very serious wound.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常严重的伤。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely it does.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: He knows his ship can't take it much longer.
sentences.zh: 他知道他的船撑不了多久了。

sentences.en: That they're being absolutely pummeled by the Spanish.
sentences.zh: 他们正遭到西班牙人的猛烈轰击。

sentences.en: And he says to the master of his ship,
sentences.zh: 他对他的船长说，

sentences.en: Okay, enough.
sentences.zh: 好了，够了。

sentences.en: Go straight for the nearest Spanish ship, which is the San Nicolás.
sentences.zh: 直奔最近的那艘西班牙船，也就是“圣尼古拉”号。

sentences.en: Just go straight for it.
sentences.zh: 直接冲过去。

sentences.en: Ram into it.
sentences.zh: 撞上去。

sentences.en: Let's do this.
sentences.zh: 就这么办。

sentences.en: The master, you know, turns the wheel.
sentences.zh: 船长转动了舵轮。

sentences.en: What's left of the wheel?
sentences.zh: 舵轮还剩下什么？

sentences.en: They head straight for the Spanish ship and they crash into the San Nicolás.
sentences.zh: 他们径直朝西班牙战舰驶去，并撞上了“圣尼古拉”号。

sentences.en: So we've just mentioned Nelson has got a massive grey splinter stuck in his stomach.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才提到纳尔逊的腹部插了一块巨大的灰色木屑。

sentences.en: Does it stop him?
sentences.zh: 这能阻止他吗？

sentences.en: Does it put him off?
sentences.zh: 这会让他退缩吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不会。

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，一点也没有。

sentences.en: By this point, he has given orders.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，他已经下达了命令。

sentences.en: Come on, we're going to do with this.
sentences.zh: 来吧，我们要这么干了。

sentences.en: We're going to board.
sentences.zh: 我们要登船作战。

sentences.en: His crew have armed themselves.
sentences.zh: 他的船员们都武装起来了。

sentences.en: They've got pikes.
sentences.zh: 他们拿着长矛。

sentences.en: They've got pistols.
sentences.zh: 他们拿着手枪。

sentences.en: Some of them have got cutlasses.
sentences.zh: 有些人拿着弯刀。

sentences.en: They've got tomahawks.
sentences.zh: 他们拿着战斧。

sentences.en: Some of them kind of butchers, knives.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至拿着屠刀。

sentences.en: They've got everything they can get their hands on.
sentences.zh: 他们拿到了所有能弄到的武器。

sentences.en: He jumps onto, I mean, this is, you know, no script writer would invent this.
sentences.zh: 他跳上了——我是说，任何编剧都想不出这样的情节。

sentences.en: He jumps onto this beam that overhangs the San Nicolás.
sentences.zh: 他跳上了悬挂在“圣尼古拉”号上方的横梁。

sentences.en: He draws his sword and he literally shouts, death or glory.
sentences.zh: 他拔出宝剑，大声喊道：不成功便成仁。

sentences.en: And then he jumps.
sentences.zh: 然后他跳了过去。

sentences.en: He jumps onto the San Nicolás.
sentences.zh: 他跳到了“圣尼古拉”号上。

sentences.en: I mean, this is like, why didn't Russell Crowe play Nelson?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就像，罗素·克劳为什么不演纳尔逊？

sentences.en: I mean, I suppose he was Captain Jack Aubrey.
sentences.zh: 我想他演过杰克·奥布瑞船长。

sentences.en: But this is a brilliant part for somebody, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 但这绝对是个适合某人的绝佳角色，对吧？

sentences.en: He jumps onto the Spanish ship.
sentences.zh: 他跳上了西班牙战舰。

sentences.en: When he gets there, he finds the Spanish ship, the San Nicolás, is already littered with bodies.
sentences.zh: 等他到了那里，他发现西班牙战舰“圣尼古拉”号上已经到处都是尸体。

sentences.en: His gunners have done their work very well.
sentences.zh: 他的炮手们干得非常出色。

sentences.en: And then there's this scene of him charging through the cabins with his men behind him, all his marines and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 接着是他在手下（所有海军陆战队员等）的簇拥下冲过船舱的场景。

sentences.en: Musket shots come at them, his marines.
sentences.zh: 迎面飞来火枪弹药，他的海军陆战队员们。

sentences.en: He steps back and his marines sort of do their work.
sentences.zh: 他退后一步，他的海军陆战队员们开始行动。

sentences.en: They keep going, fighting their way through the ship.
sentences.zh: 他们继续前进，一路杀过整艘战舰。

sentences.en: They get to the quarter deck, littered with Spanish bodies.
sentences.zh: 他们到达了后甲板，那里到处都是西班牙人的尸体。

sentences.en: And the Spanish throw down their weapons.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人扔下了武器。

sentences.en: And at this point...
sentences.zh: 就在这时……

sentences.en: He's captured the ship.
sentences.zh: 他俘获了这艘船。

sentences.en: You know, he thinks, brilliant.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他想，太棒了。

sentences.en: This alone is an incredible feat, right?
sentences.zh: 光是这一点就是个了不起的壮举，对吧？

sentences.en: No British officer has boarded and captured an enemy ship for 300 years.
sentences.zh: 已有300年没有英国军官登船俘获敌舰了。

sentences.en: It's so rare.
sentences.zh: 太罕见了。

sentences.en: And then, just as he's kind of panting...
sentences.zh: 然后，就在他气喘吁吁的时候……

sentences.en: More drama.
sentences.zh: 更多的戏剧性。

sentences.en: Another twiSt.
sentences.zh: 又一个反转。

sentences.en: Musket balls start peppering the deck.
sentences.zh: 火枪弹雨开始倾泻在甲板上。

sentences.en: And he looks up and he realizes that in the chaos, the San Nicolás has become entangled with another Spanish ship.
sentences.zh: 他抬头一看，发现在混战中，“圣尼古拉斯号”与另一艘西班牙军舰缠斗在了一起。

sentences.en: A three-decker ship called the San Jose.
